cn: 妖刀姬·绯夜猎刃 · 夜猎版

skills.name: Scarlet Prelude
skills.description: Run all you want—my blade will catch up. Attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of ATK. Level 2: 105%. Level 3: 110%. Level 4: 115%. Level 5: 125%.

skills.name: Twilight Melody
skills.description: Exclusive effect. Inflicts Bounty on selected enemy target. Bounty (General, Mark): up to 1 mark; ignores 50% DEF when attacking; gains 30% move bar at target turn end. Isolation: damage cannot be shared/redirected. Level 2: +60 SPD when Bounty target HP <90%. Level 3: damage treated as Isolation. Level 4: damage reduction and control immunity doubled when HP <60%. Level 5: targets enemy with highest SPD (non-summoned).

skills.name: Midnight Hunt
skills.description: My hunt, your doom. Attacks target 6 times, each 50% ATK. If Bounty active, extra attack on Bounty target (50% multiplier). Level 2: 55%. Level 3: +10% damage multiplier per enemy defeated (max 50%). Level 4: 60%. Level 5: when non-summoned enemy defeated, inflicts damage on lowest HP enemy at no cost (once per turn before her turn).

skills.name: Edge Rebirth
skills.description: New request? No problem. Damage taken reduced 40%. 50% chance immunity to control effects; when triggers, counters attack. Bounty active: ignores 50% DEF; gains 30% move bar at target turn end. Immobile: unable to take actions (Banish/Freeze/Sleep/etc). Link Switch: only for linked tier; cast when non-summoned target defeated → switch to UR; gain +1 turn; +100% CRIT DMG; inflict Bounty on lowest HP enemy.
